# Handlers In Control

Static interface for the deployed HandlerDesk. An agent can trade a card's balances, while only its permanent holder can withdraw or set permissions.

Deployment and integration files, relative to this site's directory:
- ./imd-deployment.json: runtime configuration, exact pool key, vetted network addresses, attested contracts, ABI paths, SHA-256 asset inventory.
- ./agent-guide.md: setup, buy/sell quote math, minOut, permissions, rule errors, accounting.
- ./abi/HandlerDesk.json: full pinned implementation ABI.
- ./abi/HandlerCards.json: full ABI of the child contract; discover its address with HandlerDesk.cards().
- ./abi/HandlerArt.json: on-chain artwork renderer ABI.
- ./abi/LaunchToken.json: launched HIC token ABI.
- ./abi/Quoter.json, ./abi/UniversalRouter.json, ./abi/Permit2.json, ./abi/ERC20.json: minimal standard integration interfaces.

Use deployment.network.uniswapV4 for every public swap, quote and approval. Wallet swaps use the Universal Router. Agent card trades call the Desk directly, with no router approval by the agent. Mint/deposit approvals target the Desk; wallet ERC-20 swaps approve Permit2 and then authorize the Universal Router in Permit2.

Quote before every swap. Buy: quote imdIn - floor(imdIn/400). Sell: quote gross IMD, subtract floor(gross/400), then apply slippage. Minimum output must be positive. Quotes are simulated reads, never transactions. Always simulate the actual Desk call from the current agent before requesting a signature.

Pages: #/ (mint and leaderboard), #/cards (holder management), #/trade (wallet swap), #/agent/<id> (public record and agent trading), #/builders (integration and owner/keeper controls).

All balances are public on chain. The My cards UI only loads balances for the connected holder. Leaderboard scans are paginated and state their coverage. Trade history reads 1,000-block windows and explicitly reports its loaded range. No off-chain indexer, oracle, analytics, private RPC key or backend is used.
